build_equality_connect_constraints: build equality connect constraints between two bodies or sites in a MuJoCo model using Warp kernels
build_equality_weld_constraints: build equality weld constraints fixing relative position and orientation between two bodies or sites
build_equality_joint_constraints: build equality joint constraints enforcing polynomial relationships between joint positions
build_contact_jacobian_sparse: build sparse contact Jacobian matrices for collision constraints with elliptic or pyramid cone types
build_contact_jacobian_dense: build dense tiled contact Jacobian matrices for collision constraints using Warp tile operations
